title: Loved the app

title: Simple and straightforward app
body: I just want to track one habit and it allows me to do that easily and simply without any extra unnecessary noise 👍

title: Amazing!
body: Best habit tracking app I’ve used. Wish you could choose which view though, so you can visualise the 365 dots to really see your progress. Just a humble suggestion! I loved it before the previous update

title: Great!
body: I downloaded this to aid me in my new year’s resolutions. It worked pretty well so far although I feel it is quite hard to function but after some time it’s okay.

title: Just what i was looking for
body: Most apps does not let me see the progress of my habits over the months. I can see at a glance how well I am doing at each habit. Took me a little while to figure out how to put in the streaks. The best part it’s free!
